title.rendered: How to Find the Best Software Development Company in Italy?

content.rendered:
Huge demand for software engineer Belgium, Italy, England, and many other countries in Europe soared to new heights during the past couple of decades. Being the fourth-largest economy in the European Union, you can find a large list of software companies in Italy that contributes to the software development industry of the country and across Europe and beyond.

Let’s have a deeper perspective on the IT industry and talk about how to find the best software development company in Italy.

IT Market in Italy

In recent years, the IT market in Italy has been transforming and expanding very rapidly. At the moment, the IT Industry Growth Rate is 5.85%, and the Tech Export Value is 38.88 billion.

The Italian IT market has achieved these high figures thanks to a combination of traditional industries and a growing technology ecosystem.

Italy has a robust IT infrastructure that is rapidly modernizing to meet the demands of the digital age. Milan, Rome and Turin have become, in fact, technology centers with a large number of companies, start-ups and research centers. You will find top IT companies in Italy right here. In total, 490k IT professionals work in 38k IT companies in the country.

Also, government support also had an impact on the growth of the IT market in Italy. Initiatives to promote digital transformation across industries have created more jobs, and investments in research and development have opened opportunities for IT professionals to improve their skills.Web development, software development, web design, UI/UX design are the most common industries in Italy, and PHP, .NET, Java, Lua, Python are the most popular programming languages.

Software Development Companies in Italy

The total number of companies related to the information and communication technology ICT is about 97,000 in 2019, as per the report cited above. A large number of those businesses are associated with software development in the country.

According to the Red Herring information, there are more than 5,500 innovative startup IT companies in Italy that are operating in the country. The number of software development companies out of those firms stands at about 2,673. In 2019, more than 1,800 startups were established. The ratio of startup companies has increased by 5.8% in 2019. Other than those startups, hundreds of big Italy software companies and SMEs are operating in the country.

Hiring Patterns

The ICT industry is already facing an acute shortage of Italy developers and other ICT talents in the local marketplace. According to THE LOCAL NEWS information, a huge number of over 76,000 ICT jobs with over 41.8% of the software developer jobs went unfilled due to the unavailability of matching talent in the local market. So, the IT companies in Italy are using multiple hiring options, such as:

  • Local hiring
  • Outsourcing
  • Outstaffing
  • Freelancer

According to the LUX Innovative information, more than 30,000 software developer vacancies remained unfilled in Italy in 2019. The prospects of running a software outsourcing company are huge to extend its software development services to the companies in Italy.

Average Software Developer Salary in Italy

As in other countries, the main number of specialists in Italy is concentrated in several large cities. And average cost to hire talents in Italy can vary from city to city. A web development company Naples may offer a lower salary than, for example, the same company in Rome. At the same time, Naples website development company is likely to pay more than a similar company in Palermo. However, let’s take a look at the average software developer salary in big cities.

  • Rome

Rome is the historical capital of Italy. The city has witnessed the integration of its rich cultural heritage with modern technological advances. The IT landscape of the city is characterized by a variety of industries. The average salary of a software developer in Rome is from €32,000 per year. The developer community here is active: approximately 10,000 to 15,000 professionals. 

  • Milan

Milan is at the forefront of IT development in Italy. In a dynamic and competitive environment, the average salary of a software developer in Milan is €37,000 per year. The city is a magnet for IT talent and boasts a sizable developer community of roughly 20,000-25,000 people.

  • Naples

Naples is also taking its place in the Italian IT scene. The average salary of a software developer in Naples is usually €26,988 per year. The city has a growing developer community of between 5,000 and 8,000 people. Any web development agency Naples will offer you different directions: website development Naples, web design and development Naples, mobile app development Naples.

  • Turin

Turin is an industrial center with a focus on automotive and manufacturing. The average salary of a software developer in Turin is about €32,000 per year. The city’s developer community has approximately 8,000 to 12,000 professionals. Turin offers promising opportunities for technology enthusiasts.

  • Palermo

Palermo is gradually making progress in the field of information technology. The average salary of a software developer in Palermo is around €31,429 per year. The developer community in Palermo has between 3,000 and 5,000 members. While still developing, Palermo offers a unique lifestyle and emerging technological vistas.
